name: First Tower (Tutorial)
summary: Learn the basics step by step: floors, rooms, transport, tenants and staff.
briefing: Quay Street has a foundation and $3M. The tutorial panel walks you through your first building one step at a time: floors, a lobby, stairs and an elevator, the plant, offices and flats, your first tenants and a janitor. Let four units and keep them through a closing to finish. There is plenty of time: nothing is lost by pausing to read.

events.message: Welcome to Quay Street. Follow the tutorial panel on the left; the game is paused until you press play.
The first daily closing is done: the economy panel shows what came in and what went out.

tutorial.title: Build the ground floor and a basement
tutorial.text: Choose Floor in the build bar (F) and drag across the foundation, once at street level and once below it. Floors are the plates everything else stands on.

tutorial.title: Open a lobby
tutorial.text: Pick Lobby and drag it across the ground floor. Everyone enters the building through the lobby.

tutorial.title: Add a stairwell
tutorial.text: A Stairwell spans two floors or more: drag it upward from the basement. People can climb a few floors; more than that and they want an elevator.

tutorial.title: Install the plant
tutorial.text: Put a Mechanical Room, an Electrical Room and a Telecom Room in the basement. Without water, climate, power and data no tenant will sign.

tutorial.title: Build two offices
tutorial.text: Build floor 1, then place two Small Offices on it. Offices pay rent and bring workers on weekdays.

tutorial.title: Add an elevator
tutorial.text: Drag an Elevator Shaft from the basement to the top floor. Resize it later by dragging its end, or with the buttons in the inspector.

tutorial.title: Build two flats
tutorial.text: Add floor 2 with two Studio Apartments. Residents live there around the clock; you can rent flats out or sell them.

tutorial.title: Let the first units
tutorial.text: Press play (1× or faster). Every hour prospects look at your vacant units; the leasing panel shows who came and why others declined.

tutorial.title: Hire a janitor
tutorial.text: Build a Staff Room in the basement, then hire a janitor in the facilities panel. Staff keep rooms clean and repair wear.

tutorial.title: Get through the first closing
tutorial.text: At 06:00 the day is closed: rent comes in, costs go out. Let all four units and keep them through a closing to finish the tutorial.

name: Opening Day
summary: Let sixteen units on Quay Street and turn a daily profit.
briefing: The Quay Street lot has a foundation and $2.5M. The harbour board wants to see a working building before the season ends: at least sixteen units let and a daily closing in the black by $12,000 or more.

events.message: The harbour board is watching: sixteen units let and a profitable closing within ten days.
Early occupancy subsidy from the harbour board for six units let
A trade fair fills the hotels — firms are looking for offices

name: Harbour Revival
summary: Bring 100 people back to the Saltmere waterfront on a tight budget.
briefing: Saltmere's harbour front has been empty for years. Land is cheap and building is cheap, but tenants are few and pay little. With $1.5M, house or employ 100 people and keep the building profitable for three days in a row.

events.message: Saltmere's fish market reopens; the harbour front is busy again.
Strike at the harbour: few people move this week
Fire inspection: the building must reach reputation 50

name: Three Properties
summary: Grow from Quay Street into an estate of three properties.
briefing: Start with the Quay Street lot and build an estate: own three properties (Ferry Lane, Crown Yard or Harbour Row are for sale), house or employ 160 people and earn $10,000 a day across the estate.

events.message: Recession: demand falls for a week
Regional development grant for owning two properties

name: Crown Prestige
summary: Raise a Class A address in Harrowgate with short elevator waits, and hold it.
briefing: Harrowgate's tenants are demanding and building is dear. With $5M, raise Crown Yard to Class A, earn a reputation of 75 and keep the average elevator wait under 30 seconds — for five closings in a row, within a month.

events.message: A consultancy group relocates to Harrowgate and seeks offices
Lift inspection: average waits must stay under 60 seconds

name: Skyline
summary: 600 people, short waits, in profit — for a week.
briefing: The big one. Grow Quay Street into a tower of at least 600 residents and workers, keep the average elevator wait under a minute and stay profitable, all for seven days running.

events.message: The city council praises the new skyline.

name: Lean Tower
summary: An office tower of twelve floors at fixed rents, with no staff to hire.
briefing: The owners want offices only, at the standard rent, and no cleaning or maintenance crew on the payroll. Build at most twelve floors on Quay Street, keep 20 units let and close the day with at least $40,000 profit for ten days running. Elevators wear out and nobody can repair them — plan your banks with spare cars.

events.message: Offices only, standard rents, no staff: every elevator counts.
A tech boom: firms want space
